tree: Golden Crust Bakery & Café in Madison, WI wants to fill slow Tuesday mornings without discounting for regulars. Owner Natalie Burke builds two segments.

tree.style: margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 14px; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: #0b1620;

tree: — Natalie selects “No visit in 180 days” plus “Within 10 miles” and sees an estimated 154 customers.
— SMS consent is applied and customers who bought in the last 7 days are excluded.
— She saves “Lapsed neighbors” and uses it in a Tuesday pastry text campaign.
— The segment recounts overnight; new opt-outs are already removed.

tree: Can segments update as customer activity changes?
Yes. Saved segments recount on a schedule, so customers join or leave as their visits, spend or consent change.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: What’s the difference between AND and OR?
AND means a customer must match every rule. OR means matching any one rule is enough. The builder shows which one is in use.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: No. Consent for the channel is always required, and unsubscribed customers are excluded automatically.

People with permission can open the list. Previews and counts are shown first, so private details aren’t displayed by default.
